subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】eleven 十一; twelve 十二; thirteen 十三; fourteen 十四; fifteen 十五; sixteen 十六; seventeen 十七; eighteen 十八; nineteen 十九; twenty 二十; kite 风筝; beautiful 美丽的
【重点句型】How many ... do you see? 你看见多少……？ I see ... 我看见…… How many ... do you have? 你有多少……？ I have ... 我有…… The black one is a bird. 黑色的是一只鸟。
【A Let's talk】Amy: Look at the kites! Zhang Peng: Wow, so beautiful! Amy: How many kites do you see? Zhang Peng: 1, 2 ... I see twelve! Amy: No! The black one is a bird!
【Read and write】How many cars do you have? I have sixteen. How many caps do you see? I see twenty. How many balls? I have eleven. How many boats? I have fifteen. Let's count!
key_points: How many ... do you see? 你看见多少……？
How many ... do you have? 你有多少……？
The black one is a bird. 黑色的是一只鸟。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
